title: The zeroth Fitting ideal of the differentials cuts out the ramification locus
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for f : X -> S locally of finite type, the closed subscheme Z cut out by Fit_0(Omega_{X/S}) is exactly the set of points where f is not unramified (source lines 1600-1605). The proof combines the description of the complement of Z as the locus where Omega_{X/S} vanishes with the standard characterisation of unramified morphisms as those whose sheaf of differentials is zero.
